description:
So you want to make Häagen Dazs Irish Cream Brownie, the infamous flavour, at home? Well now you can and it's relatively simple. 
For the Brownies, check out our video here https://youtu.be/uBvbcW-55TY and it will show you how we made these ones or you can use your favourite brownie recipe. 

What you'll need....

The Ice Cream:
340ml milk
455 ml Whipping Cream @35%
120g Sugar
35g SMP
55g Golden Syrup /Corn Syrup
3 Large egg yolks
100ml Baileys Irish Cream
0.85g stabilizer 

For the Fudge Swirl:
Fudge Sauce:
40g brown sugar
70g white sugar
25g cocoa powder
57g butter
60ml milk
1.5 tbsp corn syrup/golden syrup 
.5 tablespoon vanilla extract

 Finally for the Brownies:
110g Butter
150g Plain Flour (all purpose)
35g Cocoa Powder
1/2tsp Baking Powder
1/2tsp Salt
275g Bournville Chocolate 
275g Sugar
3 Eggs
Bake @ 160c for 22mins

If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)
